blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The prosecution presents Philippine Savings Bank Department Head of Branch Operations Irene Joy C. Ishida as its witness for Article II of the impeachment case against Vice President Sara Duterte. She was called to the witness stand to identify four active accounts among the 10 accounts maintained by Duterte and her husband, Manases “Mans” Carpio. /dp READ: LIVE UPDATES: Sara Duterte impeachment trial | Oct. 7, 2026...
